subject: Marine Works - Pattullo Bridge Deconstruction - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Pattullo Bridge Deconstruction - Fraser River
Demolition of the Pattullo Bridge will take place in the Fraser River upstream of the New Westminster Rail Bridge in the vicinity of 49 12.500N 122 53.533W.
Hours of operation:  Up to 20 hours per day, 1300 UTC to 0900 UTC.
Traffic to slow down upstream and downstream through the Project area;
- 5 knots within 100 m of shore, and
- 10 knots beyond 100 m from shore.
Contact FRPD on VHF channel 69 for instructions 90 minutes prior to transit.  
Vessels monitoring VHF Channels 16, 69, 71, and 74.
